yes, obviously it's easy to "mog" people less than you. a whole bunch of why the world has anything nice at all is that humans sometimes decided not to do that.

the ultimate problem is that both axes - the power axis and the validation axis - are both collapsed linearizations of a bunch of different factors, some of which "matter" and some of which don't. Sometimes people wind up at the bottom of a validation or power hierarchy simply due to bad luck + the Matthew effect; sometimes it takes a *lot* of grace and forgiveness and empathy to discover this. And sometimes it turns out they're exactly where they want to be! but the success and failure of various philosophies and forms of governments *tends* to point to the idea that there's a lot of untapped alpha in finding out if people can surprise you with hidden worth.

I'm just making a leap in conceptual space and compressing it, but here is the entire thought process:

I'm thinking the power axis and the validation axis can be simplified to the sex and power narratives

everything is power (postmodernism) or hedonism (sex)

this is also something jorden Peterson remarks, he says the core degenerations are sex and power

and so I was thinking what mechanism grounds this, why these 2? and I thought that the fight or flight system in the brain typically has an unspoken aspect, typically called flirt or fawn, which I called "fuck" to link it to the power and sex narrative as a shortcut for understanding

and so my conjecture is, the fight or flight brain, which is what is active when people are triggered, and is associated with the ego, and that is typically overstimulated by the media (because it makes people good consumers, according to some, like Andre from the movie dinner with andre), is the brain system that causes or creates or maintains these axes

that's where the sex and power axes come from, this part of the brain, the core survival strats

so I'm in agreement that this is degen, and that you shouldn't be ruled by your fight or flight (or fawn, which I won't call fuck, since I have explained the connotation and since the word seems to be an irritant) system
